summary: Nolus Sunoon, 34, of Denver, went missing while dirt biking in the desert north of Grand Junction; reported overdue Monday night when he didn't return home; Mesa County Sheriff's Office and ~20 Mesa County Search & Rescue volunteers searched with helicopter and airplane support after locating his vehicle; his body was found in the desert.
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search & Rescue
notes: Missing Saturday 2013-06-08, reported overdue Monday 2013-06-10, body-found update by Wednesday 2013-06-12.
